caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected at full canvas size; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A generous two-line title uses two lavender rough-lettered capsules to mark the tool and the promised output.
visual_anatomy.layout: A vertically stacked product explainer moves from a two-way change comparison to three application cards, a horizontal template-chip band, and four numbered how-it-works cards.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title and short reassurance → before/after comparison → application cards → template chips → numbered operational steps.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large light sans title, rough accent tags, uppercase band headers, bold card labels, and compact sans bullet/body text.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender, pink, aqua, and pale blue form broad horizontal washes and card accents, while white content cards preserve text contrast.
visual_anatomy.surface: White ground, banded pastel gradients, rounded outlined cards, small chips, numbered tiles, and soft shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: Two comparison cards, three application cards, five template chips, and four numbered operational cards arranged in question-led bands.
visual_anatomy.density: Medium-high: each band answers a different reader question, so the sequence remains navigable despite multiple modules.

motion.observed_state_change: The content hierarchy stays fixed while colour fills sweep through cards and chips, then the near-complete sample catches the board resetting behind a broad wipe. The samples do not establish a change in the product/process logic.
motion.motion_job: Progressive emphasis and loop reset around an otherwise static product explainer.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Move from a product’s change promise to use cases, reusable inputs, and a short operating sequence without losing orientation.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Stack reader questions in a purposeful order and give each one a distinct, repeatable card grammar rather than presenting all benefits and steps in one table.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when a product or workflow can honestly be separated into change, use cases, reusable components, and operating steps; remove any band that does not add a decision-relevant answer.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source tool, output promise, before/after claims, application labels, template categories, pastel band system, lavender marker tags, or fill-wipe loop.

claim_boundary.note: The visual contains tool capability, time, and result assertions. The corpus does not independently verify those claims or the asserted caption association.
